$comment: Structure: ngso2gso -> ngso_systems[] (-> tx_model, orbits[]) and gso_links[] (-> earth_station). Field meanings and units are in each 'description'. '$comment' entries list rules that JSON Schema cannot express; the simulator checks them when loading the file. Example files: exemplo_minimo.yaml, exemplo_completo.yaml, exemplo_multiplos_sistemas.yaml, exemplo_ancoras.yaml (same as exemplo_completo.yaml, written with YAML anchors and merge keys).
title: SHARC NGSO-to-GSO parameter file
description: Input file for sharc/ngso_to_gso.py (python sharc/ngso_to_gso.py -p <file>.yaml). Only the 'ngso2gso' section is read by the simulator; other top-level keys (e.g. 'gso_links_helpers', used for YAML anchors) are ignored. Mirrors sharc/parameters/parameters_ngso_to_gso.py. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in each description and enforced by validate() at load time.

selection_strategy.description: How each NGSO system picks its n_co_channel satellites among the visible ones (elevation > minimum_elevation and off-axis to the GSO > gso_protection_avoidance_angle). RAND: uniformly at random. MAX_ELEV: highest elevation first. WC (worst case): smallest off-axis angle to the GSO earth station's boresight first.

ngso2gso.$comment: Load-time only: max_t_s > min_t_s; ngso_systems[].label unique; (gso_links[].label, gso_links[].earth_station.label) unique. Per-system selection_strategy/minimum_elevation inherit these top-level values when omitted.
ngso2gso.description: Top-level simulation parameters (ParametersNGSO2GSO). Unknown keys are rejected by the loader. The old single-system key 'ngso' is rejected; migrate with scenarios/migrate_to_ngso_systems.py.

version.description: Parameter format version. Use 2 (or higher) to be able to set selection_strategy. If < 2, selection_strategy must NOT be set and is forced to RAND.

scenario_name.description: Name of the scenario. Used for the results directory (scenarios/results/<timestamp>/<scenario_name>) and for resuming runs.

selection_strategy.description: Default selection strategy for every NGSO system that does not override it. Required when version >= 2; forbidden when version < 2.

seed.description: Random seed. Per-time-step RNGs are spawned from it.

max_t_s.description: Simulation end time [s]. Must be greater than min_t_s. Number of steps = (max_t_s - min_t_s) / delta_t_s.

batch_size.description: Number of time steps computed per chunk before results are flushed to disk.

ref_bandwidth_Hz.description: Reference bandwidth [Hz] for noise power and for the NGSO PFD (pfd_at_ref_bandwidth_dBW_m2).

band_overlap.description: How NGSO interference into each GSO link is scaled by frequency overlap. FULL (default): every NGSO system is co-channel with every GSO link and no scaling is applied; NGSO systems must NOT set center_freq_GHz/bandwidth_MHz. FRACTION: interference from each system into each link is multiplied by the fraction of the link's band [center_freq_GHz +/- bandwidth_MHz/2] covered by the system's band; every NGSO system must set center_freq_GHz and bandwidth_MHz. The factors applied are printed at startup and saved to band_overlap.json in the results directory.

allow_zero_band_overlap.description: Only with band_overlap: FRACTION. By default, an NGSO system whose band does not overlap a GSO link at all is rejected at load time, since it would add no interference to that link and is usually a typo in a frequency. Set to true to accept it (a warning is still printed).

minimum_elevation.description: Default minimum elevation [deg] (seen from the GSO earth station) for an NGSO satellite to be considered visible. Strictly greater-than is used. Can be overridden per NGSO system.

ngso_systems.description: One entry per NGSO system (operator). Each selects its own co-channel satellites; interference from all systems is power-summed at the GSO earth station. Labels must be unique.

gso_links.description: Victim GSO links. Results are computed for each one independently. The pair (label, earth_station.label) must be unique. Note: scenarios/scenario_base.yaml sets this to null and scenario_generator.py fills it with every (link x place) combination; a file run directly must have a non-empty list.

allOf.$comment: version >= 2 requires selection_strategy; version missing or < 2 forbids it (the simulator fails with 'ValueError: AOPASA').

band_overlap: FRACTION requires center_freq_GHz and bandwidth_MHz on every NGSO system. Otherwise (FULL, the default) NGSO systems must not set them and allow_zero_band_overlap must not be true. Load-time only: with FRACTION, zero overlap between a system and a link is rejected unless allow_zero_band_overlap is true.

ngso_system.$comment: center_freq_GHz and bandwidth_MHz: both or neither (dependentRequired). Required when ngso2gso.band_overlap is FRACTION, forbidden otherwise. Interference scale factor = overlap of [fc-bw/2, fc+bw/2] with the victim band / victim bandwidth.
ngso_system.description: One NGSO system (ParametersNGSO). All its orbits share the same n_co_channel budget.

label.description: System name. Used in per-system results columns (i---<label>, epfd---<label>), so it must not contain '---'. Unique across ngso_systems.

n_co_channel.description: Nco: number of co-frequency satellites of this system transmitting toward the GSO earth station's area at each time step.

gso_protection_avoidance_angle.description: GSO arc avoidance angle [deg]. Satellites whose off-axis angle from the earth station's GSO pointing is <= this value are excluded. null/omitted disables arc avoidance.

selection_strategy.description: Optional override of ngso2gso.selection_strategy for this system.

minimum_elevation.description: Optional override of ngso2gso.minimum_elevation [deg] for this system.

center_freq_GHz.description: Emission center frequency [GHz]. Only allowed, and then required, when ngso2gso.band_overlap is FRACTION. Set together with bandwidth_MHz. Interference into each GSO link is then multiplied by the fraction of the victim's receive band covered by [fc - bw/2, fc + bw/2].

bandwidth_MHz.description: Emission bandwidth [MHz]. Only allowed, and then required, when ngso2gso.band_overlap is FRACTION. Set together with center_freq_GHz.

orbits.description: Orbital shells of this system (e.g. one entry per filing / sub-constellation).

tx_model.description: NGSO transmit model (ParametersNGSOTxModel). If omitted, CONSTANT_PFD_AT_GND at -113 dBW/m^2 is used.

model.description: Only CONSTANT_PFD_AT_GND is implemented: every selected satellite produces the same PFD at the earth station.

pfd_at_ref_bandwidth_dBW_m2.description: PFD at the ground [dBW/m^2 in ref_bandwidth_Hz].

orbit.$comment: Load-time only: apogee_alt_km >= perigee_alt_km. The six shape fields have no default: leaving any of them out is a load-time error that lists every missing field.
orbit.description: One Walker-like orbital shell (ParametersOrbit). n_planes, sats_per_plane, inclination_deg, perigee_alt_km, apogee_alt_km and phasing_deg are required; long_asc_deg, omega_deg and initial_mean_anomaly default to 0. apogee_alt_km must be >= perigee_alt_km.

apogee_alt_km.description: Apogee altitude [km]. Must be >= perigee_alt_km (equal for circular orbits).

phasing_deg.description: Phasing between satellites of adjacent planes [deg]. Irrelevant when n_planes = 1.

long_asc_deg.description: Longitude of the ascending node of the first plane [deg].

model_time_as_random_variable.description: Not used by ngso_to_gso.py (time is always stepped deterministically). Leave false.

t_min.description: Only allowed when model_time_as_random_variable is true. Not used by ngso_to_gso.py.

t_max.description: Only allowed when model_time_as_random_variable is true. Not used by ngso_to_gso.py.

gso_link.$comment: Results are named '<label>---<earth_station.label>'; that pair must be unique (load-time only). Carrier C [dBW/MHz] = eirp_dBW_per_carrier - 10*log10(bandwidth_MHz) + peak_rx_antenna_gain - added_loss - free-space loss - rain attenuation.
gso_link.description: One victim GSO downlink (ParametersGSO): satellite, link budget and receiving earth station.

label.description: Link name (e.g. 'Jupiter 97W GW'). Combined with earth_station.label as '<label>---<es label>' to name results.

orbital_slot_deg.description: GSO satellite longitude [deg], east positive (e.g. -97.1 for 97.1 W).

center_freq_GHz.description: Carrier center frequency [GHz]. Used for wavelength (antenna pattern, propagation) and, with ngso2gso.band_overlap: FRACTION, as the center of the victim band.

downlink_freq_MHz.description: Informational (low, high) downlink band edges [MHz]. Not used in the calculation. In YAML usually written as !!python/tuple [low, high]; a plain list also works.

eirp_dBW_per_carrier.description: GSO satellite EIRP over the whole carrier [dBW].

peak_rx_antenna_gain.description: Earth station peak receive antenna gain [dBi].

rx_antenna_size_m.description: Earth station antenna diameter [m]. Used for the off-axis gain pattern (D/lambda).

g_over_t_dB_per_K.description: Earth station G/T [dB/K]. Used to derive the noise temperature.

station_type.description: GW = gateway, CT = consumer terminal. Label only; does not change the math.

added_loss.description: Extra loss [dB] subtracted from the wanted carrier (C). scenario_generator.py sets 3 dB.

earth_station.description: Location of the GSO receiving earth station (ParametersGSOEarthStation).

alt_m.description: Altitude [m]. If null/omitted, taken from ITU-R topographic data (itur.topographic_altitude).
